capabilities: expand the hovered sidebar pane vertically and shrink neighbouring panes
restore each pane's original size when the pointer leaves
hold the layout still near resize handles so they stay grabbable
toggle full-height hover mode with a modifier key or command
adjust expansion amount, handle margin, and transition duration in settings
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually. Requires desktop Obsidian 1.12.3+; mobile and floating windows are unsupported. Works entirely offline with no network requests. Relies on Obsidian's sidebar DOM structure because there is no public pane-sizing API, so theme or plugin changes may require compatibility updates.
problem: Vertically stacked sidebar panes in Obsidian have fixed sizes, so a collapsed pane is hard to inspect without manually resizing or disturbing the layout.

relations.evidence: Notebook Navigator support is enabled by default. Its vertically stacked navigation and list panes expand

summary: Sidebar layout tweak that vertically expands a stacked sidebar pane on hover, borrowing height from neighbouring panes and restoring original sizes on mouse-out.
